Job Description
We are looking for a strong technical Lead to drive automation and AI initiatives, combining hands-on engineering expertise with technical leadership. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in Playwright, Java/Python, Generative AI, and DevOps .
Key Responsibilities:
Lead the design and development of scalable test automation frameworks using Playwright .
Develop AI-driven solutions using RAG and AI Agents to improve automation and engineering efficiency.
Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines and follow DevOps best practices.
Define automation strategy, technical standards, and best practices across projects.
Lead and mentor automation engineers and collaborate with engineering, QA, and product teams.
Evaluate and implement emerging AI and automation technologies .
Key Qualifications:
Strong hands-on experience with Playwright and Java and/or Python .
Hands-on experience with RAG implementation and AI Agent development .
Practical experience with CI/CD and DevOps .
Proven technical leadership and experience leading automation initiatives.
Strong software engineering and problem-solving skills.
Preferred
Experience in the Recruiting/HR domain is an added advantage.
Exposure to LLMs, vector databases, embeddings, and AI frameworks is preferred.


Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
